# StardewUtils — The All-in-One Utility Mod

Six of the most requested Stardew Valley cheats packed into a single lightweight mod,
all controllable with hotkeys while you play. No SMAPI. No dependencies. Just drop it
in and go.

---

## Features

| Hotkey | What it does |
|--------|-------------|
| F5 | Freeze/unfreeze the clock — time stops completely |
| F6 | Toggle infinite stamina — never run out of energy |
| F7 | Toggle infinite health — become invincible in the mines |
| F8 | Add 999,999 gold to your wallet instantly |
| F9 | Instantly grow every crop on your farm to harvest-ready |
| F10 | Max out friendship (10 hearts) with every villager |

A HUD notification pops up in-game whenever you toggle a feature so you always
know what's active.

---

## Requirements

- Stardew Valley (Steam or Xbox Game Pass)
- PawLoader mod launcher — download it [url=https://github.com/RavanaCraftMC/PawLoader/releases]here[/url]

## Installation

1. Download and install PawLoader
2. Open PawLoader and add Stardew Valley
3. Click "+ install .dll" and select StardewUtils.dll
4. Click "> launch" — hotkeys are active as soon as your farm loads

## Notes

- All features are toggleable — nothing is permanent until you save
- Time freeze works anywhere including mines and events 
- Crop growth (F9) only affects your farm, not Greenhouse or Island Farm
- Friendship cap is 10 hearts for regular villagers
- Press hotkeys only after your save has fully loaded, not on the main menu

## Compatibility

Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+. Compatible with most other mods since
StardewUtils does not patch any game files.
